findings.title: Followed desire as the hinge toward perdition
findings.claim: The definite desire field becomes the practical direction of the successor group and stands immediately before the final perdition clause.
findings.mechanism: The object of the completed following predicate is a recognized plural field, and its placement makes desire-following contact the later encounter with ruin.
findings.reader_payoff: The final consequence reads as a route reached through adopted appetites, not as an unrelated addition.
findings.containment: This preserves the ordinary claim that they followed desires; it does not claim that every desire or every external comparison is active here.

epistemic.reason: The supplied word-analysis evidence directly joins the object, predicate, and result position.

findings.title: A recognized field of desires
findings.claim: The object is a definite plural field of desires rather than one vague or passing impulse.
findings.mechanism: The definite plural is resolved as the direct object of following, so many recognized appetitive pulls occupy the object position together.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive dispersion across a known field of attractions.
findings.containment: The finding keeps the ordinary plural desires intact and does not infer a separate catalogue beyond the supplied evidence.

epistemic.reason: The supplied morphology and object relation directly support the claim.

findings.title: One ordered practice against many pulls

findings.mechanism: The two verb-object predicates coordinate a singular institutional object with a plural desire field, making the conduct an exchange of direction.
findings.reader_payoff: Neglect and pursuit become one moral profile rather than two unrelated details.
findings.containment: This adds relation between the supplied objects without ranking one latent line over another or replacing the literal accusation.

epistemic.reason: Both object structures and their coordination are supplied in the packet.

findings.title: The result belongs to both charges

findings.reader_payoff: The future encounter is read as the announced result of the whole preceding pair.
findings.containment: The two prior acts remain distinct; the causal relation does not collapse them into one act.

epistemic.reason: The supplied attachment and particle evidence explicitly scopes the result clause.

findings.title: Singular institution with bounded distributive pressure

epistemic.reason: The object opposition is grounded and the hinge is a bounded supplied syntactic inference.

findings.containment: The comparison illuminates the local object choice and does not import a separate narrative into the focus ayah.

epistemic.reason: The local object relation is grounded and the intertextual contrast is supplied as bounded evidence.

findings.reader_payoff: The failure is a change in direction of commitment, not mere exposure to temptation.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim that they followed desires remains intact; the directional inversion is a qualified relation around it.

epistemic.reason: The form and object are local, while the reversal is an interpretive comparison explicitly supplied in the packet.

findings.claim: The supplied trace presents occupants of an inherited place who break a worship-bearing relay: the ayah diagnoses failed succession while retaining the ordinary temporal sequence.
